To pray about the {{ls}}ixt houre.''] {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Canonical houres.}}The houre is {{ls}}pecified, for that there vvere certaine appointed times of praier v{{ls}}ed in the Lavv, vvhich deuout per{{ls}}ons, according to the publike {{ls}}eruice in the Temple, ob{{ls}}erued al{{ls}}o priuately: and vvhich the Apo{{ls}}tles and holy Church aftervvard both kept and increa{{ls}}ed.
